method: Every row read from the live table with a SELECT on 2026-09-30 (md5 of id|year|winner|school|position|class over all 91 rows, ordered by id: 673fbd5b7f866475520cd118bc3de8dc). Each row checked against the award body (heisman.com/heisman-winners/, read from the raw page's per winner data attributes) and ESPN's all time list with positions. Year, winner and school were also read against ESPN's winners list. A value ships only where both sources agree; where they print the same person, school or role two ways, the note on the row says which form is kept and why. Wikipedia was not used.
positionRule: The award body's position code, which ESPN matches on 88 rows and prints as the same role on the other 3 (HB against RB for 1937 and 1944, CB/WR against WR/CB for 2024). Both sources list the running backs of every era as RB (two fullbacks as FB, two halfbacks as HB on heisman.com), the two way ends of 1936 and 1949 as TE, and give no second role to Kinnick, Horvath or Janowicz, so the table's era codes HB, E, HB/QB and HB/P were corrected to what both print.
classRule: class is not one of the verified fields. The 10 rows that carry one agree with heisman.com and are kept; the 81 empty ones stay empty rather than filled from one source.

notes: heisman.com writes Clinton Frank, ESPN writes Clint Frank; the table keeps the award body's spelling.
